name: Jaguar F-Type R SVT
description: The Jaguar F-Type R represents the pinnacle of Jaguar's sports car lineup, combining British grand touring elegance with genuine supercar performance. This SVT variant pushes the supercharged 5.0-liter V8 engine beyond the standard F-Type R's 575 hp output to produce 675 hp and 860 Nm of torque, delivering breathtaking acceleration and a thunderous exhaust note. The rear-wheel-drive configuration offers a purer, more engaging driving experience compared to the all-wheel-drive models, placing greater emphasis on driver skill and involvement. Power is delivered through an eight-speed Quickshift automatic transmission with paddle shifters. The F-Type features Jaguar's aluminum-intensive architecture for optimal weight distribution, along with adaptive dynamics, torque vectoring, and an electronic active differential for precise handling. With its long hood, short rear deck, and muscular proportions, the F-Type continues Jaguar's tradition of building beautiful, powerful sports cars.
